cohort: The study included neonates admitted to a tertiary neonatal intensive care unit in Timisoara, Romania, comprising 44 neonates with microbiologically confirmed Gram-negative infections and 47 matched controls without infection.
finding: Gram-negative perinatal infections were associated with considerable morbidity, with male sex and vaginal delivery being significantly associated with infection.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was significantly associated with Gram-negative bacterial infection (43.2% in infected vs. 17.0% in controls; p = 0.00001).
